findings.claim: The conditional probability, logistic loss, row/column cancellation, and a=b exception are mathematically correct.
findings.correction: Retain the product-pseudo-joint qualification. For a≠b, CE(q1,a)+CE(q2,b) = conditional_NLL - log P({a,b}); the conditional objective discards the probability assigned to the conditioning event.

findings.claim: Both abstract logit counterexamples correctly disprove individual-query correctness from a large positive D.
findings.correction: Continue labeling them abstract examples. They demonstrate margin compensation and third-class domination without establishing native-circuit realizability.

findings.claim: The separate native free-bias transformation follows from the supplied additive-bias head equation.
findings.correction: For d outside {a,b}, choose Δ > max(0, max over i∈{1,2}, c≠d of [z(i,c)-z(i,d)]). Increasing bias[d] by Δ makes both predictions d while preserving D exactly. More generally, the conditional loss has zero derivative with respect to every explicit class bias. This is an analytic parameter-family result, not an executed intervention.

findings.claim: The result defeats a guarantee based solely on conditional-loss bias cancellation.
findings.correction: It does not establish that CE plus this auxiliary loss is ineffective, untrainable, or worse than CE. Bias invariance of the objective also establishes no entity-input invariance or robustness of the original inference rule.

findings.claim: The proposed source-transfer boundaries are consistent with the supplied reading summaries.
findings.correction: Keep literature conclusions scoped to the inspected portions. Generic multi-input quantum conditioning has a supplied precedent; this is not a complete novelty audit. A numeric class-index residual penalty lacks the supplied ordinal justification for Re-TACRED.

claim_ceiling: A standard conditional-likelihood identity and a native additive-bias counterexample establish that this objective alone cannot guarantee correctness of the original independent 40-class predictions. No quantum-specific advantage, empirical failure of CE-plus-pair training, or broader impossibility follows.

implementation_recommendation.reason: The corrected surviving result supports retaining an analytic exclusion, not allocating implementation or coefficient/seed searches now. No additional discriminating full-decision prediction is established.
